long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in New Orleans's working-class Seventh Ward, Thomas Milton Benson Jr. served in the Navy before becoming a bookkeeper at a Chevrolet dealership. A mentor sent him to manage a struggling San Antonio outlet and gave him a minority stake. Benson eventually gained full control, built a regional dealership network and invested its profits in Southern banks.

When the Saints faced a possible move, Benson bought the franchise in 1985 and kept it in New Orleans. The team reached the playoffs for the first time under his ownership and later won Super Bowl XLIV. He added the NBA's Hornets, renamed the Pelicans, in 2012. His foundations and businesses also supported schools, hospitals, faith-based organizations and community rebuilding after Hurricane Katrina.
